description: List SEC EDGAR filings accepted for the companies Seraphix covers, newest first: company, CIK, form, 8-K item codes and titles, SEC acceptance time (source_date), accession number and the SEC filing URL (source_url). Insider and ownership forms (3, 4, 5, 144, SC 13D/G) are excluded. Notices are machine-extracted index metadata (tier "machine-extracted"), not reviewed records; read the filing itself before relying on it. Optional filters: company, since (acceptance time on or after an ISO 8601 date or date-time), limit. If the wire is unavailable the tool returns an error (isError) with its last good check instead of an empty list.

company.description: Restrict to one covered company: name, SEC CIK or slug.

since.description: Only filings accepted on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-05T13:00:00Z.

name: get_filings_wire

status.description: OBSERVED = the source object validated and is within its freshness window. DEGRADED = late, missing or invalid; values may be older than expected.

title: SEC filings wire
